description: Lists every signal you can screen on: the built-ins and your custom signals, in one catalog you can filter, search and page. Use to discover the signal names and `q` vocabulary before composing a scan; custom signals appear with `kind: custom`. Narrow it with `category`, `group`, `type`, `search` and `select=type,description` rather than reading all ~460 rows.

asset_class.description: Signals that apply to this asset class (one or a comma list), e.g. `crypto`. Values: stocks, rates, crypto, fx.

category.description: One category or a comma list (`oscillators,trend`). Each signal carries its `category`. Values: trades_quotes, bars, session_structure, highs_lows, support_resistance, volume_levels, volume_activity, performance, gaps, intraday_momentum, ranges, moving_averages, oscillators, trend, volatility_bands, income_statement, balance_sheet, cash_flow, margins_ratios, valuation, share_structure, short_interest, earnings, dividends, ipos, capital_changes, insider_activity, classification, identity, company, fund_facts, consensus_ratings, analyst_actions, price_targets, estimates, news.

cursor.description: The previous response's `next_cursor`. Send it with the same params as the first page (`limit` may change); a page whose params differ is a 400 naming the param.

grain.description: Signals with stored history at this grain (one or a comma list): what an as-of read or the history read can serve at it. Values: 1m, 1h, 1d.

group.description: One taxonomy group or a comma list (`technicals,fundamentals`). Each signal carries its `group`. Values: price, volume, price_action, technicals, fundamentals, events, profile, analyst, news.

kind.description: Filter by kind (one or a comma list). Omit to return both. Values: builtin, custom.

limit.description: Page size over the whole list: your custom signals (newest first), then the built-ins A→Z. Max 500 until 2027-01-12, then 100 (a larger value is clamped to the max, not an error; `next_cursor` pages the rest; see Deprecations). Omitted, every matching signal comes back in one response until 2027-01-12; after that a call pages at a default limit.

refresh.description: Signals that update on this schedule (one or a comma list). Values: 1m_4am_8pm_et, 1m_24_7, 5m, 10m, 15m, 30m, 1h, daily, daily_after_close, weekly, monthly, quarterly, on_event, static, custom.

search.description: Case-insensitive text match on the name and description. Results are ranked: an exact name match first, then names that start with the term, then names that contain it, then descriptions that have it as a whole word, then descriptions that contain it; list order within each rank. Paging a search never repeats or skips.

select.description: The fields each row carries (`name` is always included), e.g. `type,description`.

type.description: One value type or a comma list. Custom signals are always `boolean`. Values: numeric, boolean, string, date, timestamp, object, string[].

name: tickerbot_list_signals
